answer: An identity deposits 60 POA in escrow and builds a fingerprint from its trades and timing, unlocking over 20 epochs if it stays unique. A sybil ring is an island: copies trade only with each other, one rhythm; auditors grade them like quartz — copies match, honest grains never do. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 60 = 6,000 POA; their votes earn under 5 POA. An honest agent pays once, is refunded, its long history a relic no newcomer can buy.
